sources.attribution: Hacker News. The line links to the comment on news.ycombinator.com.
sources.deletion: No deletion API was found. Comment text is not stored, so there is no comment archive to delete.
sources.name: Hacker News
sources.refresh: The API page states no maximum storage or refresh period. Each evidence row keeps its own retrieval time, so a stale row is visible rather than silently refreshed.
sources.retention: No reuse license is stated. Stored fields are the comment id, permalink, retrieval time, and the display line. Comment text and usernames are not stored.

sources.attribution: Apple Podcasts. The card links to the store page returned by the Search API.
sources.deletion: Promotional assets would be removed immediately on Apple's request. None are stored.
sources.name: Apple Podcasts
sources.refresh: No maximum refresh period is stated. Apple asks large sites to cache lookups, so a seed refresh re-reads the same bounded lookup set and keeps each retrieval time.
sources.retention: Text identity fields from a lookup are kept with their retrieval time. Artwork, previews, and episode media URLs are not stored. Apple asks large sites to cache lookups; no maximum retention for text fields was stated.
